name: processj-lsp-vscode
description: ProcessJ language support: diagnostics, type checking, formatting, semantic highlighting, run from the editor.

processj.installDir.description: ProcessJ install directory (with bin/ and resources/jars). Empty: use installdir from ~/processjrc or $PROCESSJ_HOME. Changes restart the server automatically.

processj.javaBin.description: Java executable used for compiler diagnostics and Run. Empty: use $JAVA_HOME/bin/java or java on PATH.

processj.checkOnChange.description: Also run the real compiler on every edit (default: only on open and save; the built-in checker runs as you type).

processj.lint.description: Run the built-in type checker and concurrency lints.

processj.codeLens.description: Show Run and Build code lenses above main. The commands remain available from the editor title and Command Palette when disabled.

processj.debounceMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last edit before starting a compiler check when checkOnChange is enabled.

processj.timeoutMs.description: Maximum duration in milliseconds for one compiler diagnostic run.

processj.runTimeoutMs.description: Maximum duration in milliseconds for a program launched with ProcessJ: Run Current File.

processj.serverPath.description: Path to processj-lsp.js (a leading ~ is supported). Empty: use the bundled server. Changes restart the language client automatically.

processj.trace.server.description: Trace messages exchanged with the ProcessJ language server in the ProcessJ Language Server Trace output channel.

scripts.install-extension: node scripts/build.js && vsce package --no-dependencies --out processj.vsix && code --install-extension processj.vsix --force
